offering_description.value: Develops, manufactures and sells regenerative medicine products, mainly advanced wound care and surgical biologics, to hospitals, wound care clinics, physician offices and surgeons. Products include placental-derived tissues, skin substitutes and musculoskeletal products such as a knee osteoarthritis injection, made in company facilities.

primary_products.value: advanced wound care skin substitutes; amniotic tissue allografts; surgical biologics; bone graft and musculoskeletal products; knee osteoarthritis injection

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, wound care centers, physician offices, ambulatory surgery centers, surgeons; B2G: Veterans Affairs and other federal healthcare facilities

end_markets.value: advanced wound care; surgical and sports medicine; orthopedics; healthcare

revenue_model.value: product sales: skin substitutes, biologic grafts and injectables sold to providers, with payment largely reimbursed by Medicare and insurers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: processes human tissue and biomaterials into regenerative products, sold to clinicians and healthcare facilities; brand owner: markets own branded wound care and surgical products

geography_served.value: global: Primarily United States, with limited sales in other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: advanced wound care and surgical biologics, plus musculoskeletal products, sharing clinician customers and tissue technology

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: company sales representatives selling to physicians, clinics and hospitals; distributors / dealers: independent distributors and agents, and government supply channels

regulatory_exposure.value: high: products regulated by FDA as tissue products and devices, Medicare coverage and reimbursement rules (CMS) strongly affect sales

notes: Product mix and Medicare coverage changes may have shifted; details are from memory.
